image_description: A low-angle shot of a massive radio telescope dish, viewed from below. The structure features a large, circular parabolic reflector with a solid-looking rim and a complex white steel lattice support structure (truss work) underneath. Trees are visible in the foreground at the bottom left and right, providing scale. The sky is overcast.

The rim of the dish forms a consistent elliptical projection indicative of a circular parabolic shape viewed from an angle. The underside structure follows this curvature logically.

The rectangular box-like structure attached to the left rim of the dish has ill-defined edges and seems to merge slightly with the rim's edge. Its structural connection is ambiguous and lacks clear mechanical logic.
